en-US.name: Spoken Letter
en-US.summary: Play the family stories delivered to your Spoken Letter account on your Echo.
en-US.description: Spoken Letter plays family stories already delivered to your account. Ask for the newest story, a story from a storyteller, or the next one. You can also prepare a name-free demo story outline. Choose a listener, finish delivery, and manage credits in the Spoken Letter app. Development stage only: this skill is tested on the Owner's devices and is not submitted for certification.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask spoken letter to play the story Aunt Whitney sent
Alexa, ask spoken letter what is new

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development stage. Say: open spoken letter; play the story Aunt Whitney sent; what is new; next; start over; shuffle on; pause; resume; let's create a story; about mermaids; read my demo draft; how do I add credits. Playback uses fixture recordings. Drafts are saved only for the demo and are not delivered.
